capabilities: define React components in jsx code blocks with namespace and frontmatter properties
create components from whole notes in a designated folder (component notes)
render components in notes using block and inline syntax
access React hooks, ReactDOM and frontmatter through ReactComponentContext
problem: Obsidian notes are static Markdown with no built-in way to define or reuse interactive React components inside the vault.

relations.evidence: It is highly recommended that you also install the Editor Syntax Highlight Plugin when using this plugin.
or (if dataview is installed) using dataview inline properties

summary: Lets users write and render React JSX components inside notes, defined in code blocks or as whole-note component files.
